runtime_observation_contract.collision_policy: passive bounded evidence only; absence of the topic or events never blocks preflight or changes control/planning
runtime_observation_contract.sensor_policy: a fresh 36-stream/13-actor CARLA source audit is required; this runner neither publishes nor synthesizes sensor data
runtime_observation_contract.readiness_policy: physical actor id and strict PHYSX_FOUR_WHEEL_STEERING readiness must remain unchanged for the whole mission

runtime.motion_path: visible Guest browser page -> page-owned Guest WebSocket navigate/usage_complete -> camrod_ui_guest ROS commands -> typed PlanningRecallRequest / roadside wait (RETURN source guest:usage_complete) -> CAMROD planning -> CAMROD control -> CARLA physical 4WS bridge

per_site_metric_contract.elapsed_s: frontend dispatch attempt through final PASS/FAIL
per_site_metric_contract.milestones[].elapsed_s: live per-site preflight start through milestone
per_site_metric_contract.outbound_duration_s: frontend dispatch attempt through frontend return request
per_site_metric_contract.return_duration_s: frontend return request attempt through PARKED+CHARGING
per_site_metric_contract.outbound_distance_m: CARLA odometry accumulated from dispatch to WAIT_RETURN
per_site_metric_contract.return_distance_m: CARLA odometry accumulated from return request to final
per_site_metric_contract.total_odom_distance_m: CARLA odometry accumulated from dispatch to final
